d: After a massive 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) has officially arrived—unlocking in India at 12:00 AM IST on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. As gamers dive into the sprawling open world of Leonida and Vice City, the blockbuster launch also shines a spotlight on a major Indian milestone behind the scenes. Bengaluru South MP Tejasvi Surya revealed that over 1,600 developers at Rockstar India’s Whitefield studio played a significant role in crafting GTA 6—contributing to open-world environments, digital assets, and iconic locations such as Vice Beach.
